results.remarks: Stunning Mid-Century home built in 1959, reimagined for today's living while retaining many original details. Property is on a quiet cul-de-sac, close to amenities and the renowned El Paseo shopping and dining area. Updated in 2019/2020 with the following: flooring throughout, electrical panel, HVAC system, roof,  water heater,  appliances, fireplace, paint/wallpaper and kitchen countertops. The home opens into a vestibule with a small beverage fridge niche and continues to a large open great room with living space, dining area and kitchen. There are two primary bedrooms, each with its own bath, and ample closets. Walls of glass enhance the great room and draws your attention to the large fenced-in backyard. There are three patio spots- one for dining, and two for lounging. There is a  small citrus grove with two lemon trees, a grapefruit tree and a pomelo tree and a huge olive tree produces olives. The landscape features mostly desert-friendly plants, trees and bushes with two grassy islands in the backyard. The large curved drive takes you to the two-car carport, that houses the utilities in one closet and the washer/dryer in the second. The property comes furnished with original Mid-Century pieces and modern pieces that blend in seamlessly. This gem will not last long

results.remarks: A study in modern desert elegance, this residence in Palm Desert's sought-after University Park community presents a seamless blend of clean architectural lines and vibrant contemporary design.  The entry makes an immediate statement, as a dramatic staircase rises beneath soaring ceilings, its clean-lined railing tracing a bold architectural silhouette.  Hardwood-style plank flooring grounds the main level, where linear sightlines and curated contrasts define the open-concept living spaces. Also on the main level, a flexible den currently styled as a game lounge offers versatility, ideal as a media room, creative studio, office, or additional gathering space. A private pool and spa shimmer beneath expansive desert skies, framed by patio spaces designed for alfresco dining, sun soaked afternoons, and twilight gatherings. Life at University Park extends beyond the home itself, residents enjoy access to The Grove, a vibrant community hub featuring multiple resort pools and spas, pickleball and bocce courts, a fitness center, playground, outdoor cooking areas, and expansive event lawns. Moments from premier shopping, dining, golf, and parks, this home offers a refined yet effortless desert lifestyle. Home is being sold furnished and includes an owned solar system.

results.remarks: Updated Single-Level Living in Golden Sun EstatesSet on a corner lot behind the gates of Golden Sun Estates, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,363 square feet of open, single-level living that has been thoughtfully refreshed. New LVP flooring runs through the main living areas and bedrooms, new windows bring in clean natural light, updated appliances, and the HVAC system is newer, so the major systems are handled and the home is ready from day one.The layout flows without interruption from the front entry through the living room, dining area, and kitchen, with tall ceilings and display ledges that keep the rooms feeling airy. The living room sits under a vaulted ceiling and opens to a large slider and picture window, carrying light through the space all day. The adjacent dining area shares that same connection to the outdoors, with a second slider to the covered patio.The kitchen is functional and full of character, with sage cabinetry, granite tile counters, new stainless steel appliances, and a garden window over the sink. A built-in coffee and beverage nook and a breakfast bar with seating round out a layout that works as well for quiet mornings as it does for hosting.The three bedrooms are positioned for privacy, with one offering mountain and palm views through the front window. The primary bath features a dual-sink vanity and a separate walk-in shower, with a second full bath serving the additional rooms.Outside, an alumawood-covered patio extends the living space into a shaded, private retreat with room for lounge seating, dining, and a grill. Mature landscaping wraps the corner lot and adds a layer of seclusion.Golden Sun Estates is a gated community with a low monthly HOA of $180, a central greenbelt, a community pool and spa, a tennis court, and open lawns framed by the Santa Rosa and San Jacinto mountains. The location puts you minutes from shopping, dining, and golf across Palm Desert and the surrounding valley.With the updates already done and the systems in good shape, this one lives well as a lock-and-leave. For second-home owners and those splitting time with the desert, the mix of low upkeep, a secure gated entry, and a modest HOA is the part that is hard to replicate, and it is what keeps homes like this in demand season after season

results.remarks:
SUBSTANTIAL PRICE DROP! Welcome to Genesis, one of Palm Desert's newer gated communities, where modern living, convenience, and low-maintenance desert living come together beautifully. Situated on a desirable cul-de-sac and just moments from the community amenities, this thoughtfully designed single-family home offers 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms with a versatile and highly functional floor plan.
Upon entry, two guest bedrooms and an upgraded bathroom featuring a spacious walk-in shower provide a welcoming space for family and visitors. The heart of the home unfolds into an open-concept great room highlighted by a beautifully upgraded kitchen with center island, bar seating, abundant cabinetry, and seamless flow into the dining and living areas.
French doors from the dining space open to a private backyard retreat featuring low-maintenance landscaping and a variety of mature fruit trees, creating an ideal setting for outdoor dining, morning coffee, or simply enjoying the desert sunshine. The spacious living area offers the perfect gathering place for entertaining, movie nights, or relaxing with family and friends.
The home continues with an additional guest bedroom, another upgraded bathroom with walk-in shower, and a convenient laundry room. Tucked away for maximum privacy, the primary suite enjoys its own private hallway entrance and serves as a peaceful sanctuary. The generous bedroom is complemented by a beautifully updated ensuite bath with a large walk-in shower and an expansive closet offering abundant storage and hanging space.
Residents of Genesis enjoy 2 gated entry points,  low HOA dues and an impressive collection of community amenities, including a pool, spa, fitness center, dog park, and scenic walking paths throughout the neighborhood. Ideally located near Acrisure Arena, world-class shopping and dining on El Paseo, and with easy access to Palm Springs, Rancho Mirage, and La Quinta, this exceptional home is perfectly suited for both full-time residents and seasonal desert getaways.

results.remarks: Better Than New! Why buy a builder-grade home when you can own one that's already complete? This beautifully upgraded 2023 home in the desirable Dolce community features 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and 2,064 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with 9-foot ceilings throughout and appliances included (kitchen appliances, refrigerator/freezer, washer/dryer). Premium upgrades include a paid 12-panel solar system, wood-grain porcelain tile flooring throughout the main level, quartz countertops, a custom full-height chevron backsplash, tankless water heater, upgraded honeycomb and pull shades, window coverings, ceiling fans in every bedroom and living space, and overhead garage storage—providing comfort, style, and functionality from day one. Step outside to a private backyard retreat featuring a flagstone patio, premium pergola with adjustable louvers and privacy curtains, an India Laurel privacy hedge, raised garden beds, citrus trees, professionally designed drought-tolerant landscaping, and automatic irrigation in both the front and back yards. A 14-foot trampoline may also be included with the sale. Conveniently located with easy access to Interstate 10 via Monterey Avenue, this home offers a peaceful residential setting while remaining close to shopping, dining, and other local amenities. With extensive indoor and outdoor improvements already completed, this home is ready for its next owner to move in and enjoy. results.remarks: Welcome to Regency Palms In Palm Desert! This single-family home has had one owner and has been well cared for.  The home offers 2015 square feet of living space with three large bedrooms and two and a half baths. The oversized lot provides ample space for entertaining or sit back and relax to soak in the beautiful desert weather. The spacious open floorplan has high ceilings and is perfect for families or for hosting guests. As you enter the home you are greeted with a large living room with a gas fireplace that looks out to the beautiful back yard and pool area. The open kitchen features granite counter tops, solid wood cabinetry, gas stove, and a breakfast room. The formal dining area off the kitchen can also be used as a den or office space.  The primary bedroom is quite large lending space to create a cozy reading/den area and has private access to the pool area. Additionally, the primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a large bathroom with double sinks, a separate shower, and soaking tub. The two guest bedrooms share the second full bath and a both have large walk-in closets. results.remarks: Experience elegance, sophistication, glamour and exceptional desert living in this gorgeously updated Italian-inspired residence located within the gated community of Brava in Palm Desert. From sparkling chandeliers to thoughtfully upgraded finishes, this magnificent home makes an impressive statement at every turn. Approximately five minutes from El Paseo, this beautifully appointed residence offers an extraordinary combination of style, comfort, efficiency, and location. A home filled with so much class and pride of ownership, this one is truly a must see, the absolute best of the best in Brava!

results.remarks: Price improvement! This lovely home is located in a beautiful 55+ community in the Del Webb Sun City in Palm Desert. This St. Croix is one of the most popular models in Sun City. results.remarks: This Hidden Palms home is anything but your average condo. Perfectly positioned on one of the largest lots in the community, this rare detached residence with no shared interior walls offers exceptional privacy, an attached two-car garage, expansive outdoor living, and breathtaking unobstructed western skyline views that create unforgettable Palm Desert sunsets.Thoughtfully remodeled with contemporary finishes and tasteful vintage touches, this exceptional residence seamlessly blends modern comfort with timeless character. Continuous wood-look porcelain flooring extends throughout the home, creating a sophisticated, cohesive design while remaining naturally cooler underfoot during warm desert days. Multiple skylights fill the interior with abundant natural light, enhancing the bright, open floor plan and inviting atmosphere.Designed with both everyday living and entertaining in mind, the chef's kitchen features stunning quartz countertops with a waterfall-edge island, custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, upgraded appliances, a built-in wine refrigerator, and an elegant custom dry bar. Coordinated cabinetry, countertops, and flooring flow consistently throughout the home, giving the entire residence a custom-designed feel.The spacious living room is centered around an impressive oversized gas fireplace, creating a warm focal point that flows effortlessly into the dining area and outdoor living spaces. results.remarks: Such a quality Tuscan home at an affordable price! Enjoy life at Villa Portofino, a premier 55+ community in Palm Desert. This desirable Florence plan offers high end European finishes that match the theme of the community and the exquisite clubhouse decor and its luxurious amenities!  The home features two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a study with built-in bookshelves, a great room, 2 fireplaces, wet bar, and a patio with lush landscaping. The home has an attached two-car garage with extra space. Elegant architectural Tuscan design features include a dramatic 20 ft high entry foyer, Dramatic great room with dining and wet bar, custom solid maple cabinetry throughout; eight-foot solid core interior doors. Travertine stone flooring is featured predominately throughout. Carpet is in the bedrooms. Custom stone accents, and classic Old World clay tile roofing enhance the home's timeless appeal. Eight-foot French doors and windows feature energy-efficient Low-E insulated glass, spa-inspired bathrooms with imported stone surrounds, including a primary bath with separate tub and walk-in shower. Additional features include R-38 ceiling insulation and insulated walls for enhanced temperature and sound control. The Villa Portofino community enjoy a 30,000-square-foot clubhouse with amenities, including concierge services, movie theater, bistro, pool, yoga studio, fitness center, library, a nine hole putting course with lake features, card and meeting rooms. Ideally located near Eisenhower Medical Center, El Paseo shopping and dining, The McCallum Theatre, top shopping markets  and restaurants.

results.remarks: Welcome to Whitehawk -- Where Desert Living Meets Everyday Elegance Nestled in the heart of one of Palm Desert's most sought-after gated communities, this beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers 2,660 square feet of refined desert living at its finest. From the moment you step through the front door, you'll appreciate the thoughtful design, soaring ceilings, and seamless flow that make this home as livable as it is impressive. Stone tile flooring runs throughout the entire home -- cool underfoot, easy to maintain, and the perfect canvas for desert-modern living. The recently updated kitchen is a true showstopper, featuring a center island with granite countertops and premium Thor appliances that will delight the home chef, complemented by stylish finishes that strike the perfect balance between function and flair. One of the property's most coveted features is its prime location directly across from the community park -- enjoy front-row views of green open space and a relaxed neighborhood feel that is increasingly rare to find. Step outside and cool off in your private pool, the perfect desert retreat for relaxing afternoons and entertaining under the sun. The home is also equipped with solar, helping improve energy efficiency while keeping utility costs in check during the warm desert months.With four generously sized bedrooms and three full bathrooms, there's room for the whole family, out-of-town guests, or a dedicated home office. The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat, while the additional bedrooms provide flexibility for every lifestyle. Beyond your front door, Whitehawk delivers the gated community lifestyle you've been dreaming of -- low HOA dues, wide well-lit streets, and a central Palm Desert location minutes from acclaimed restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and easy freeway access. Sports lovers will appreciate being just 10 minutes from the Acrisure Arena, the Indian Wells Tennis Garden, and world-class golf courses including Desert Willow. This is more than a home -- it's a lifestyle. Welcome to Whitehawk.

A great opportunity for investors seeking an income-producing multifamily property with potential for future upside.

results.remarks: Enjoy your morning coffee on the sunny east facing patio of this spectacularly reimaged Monterey Country Club 300 Plan condominium. Featuring two bedrooms, a den/office and three baths, this beautiful home sits on a quiet interior cul-de-sac with one of Monterey's 37 community pools and spas just steps away. The unit's interior has been opened up to create a true great room with kitchen, dining area and living space combined. The kitchen features custom cabinets, granite countertops, large island, pantry and Kitchen Aid stainless steel appliances including a five burner gas cooktop. All bathrooms have been beautifully updated and a powder room has been added. The primary suite features a tray ceiling and walk-in closet. All rooms include LED recessed lighting and ceiling fans and all interior doors are solid wood. A tankless water heater was added when the unit was updated and the owners recently installed a new energy efficient heat pump HVAC system. The home also has motorized Hunter Douglas window treatments throughout. The unit's extended patio is perfect for entertaining and overlooks the seventh green of the West Course. It also has retractable awnings for afternoon shade. If you're looking for perfection, this home is it! Move right in and start enjoying the Monterey lifestyle! results.remarks: VALUE PRICE OPPORTUNITY & FAST-CLOSING BONUS!   Capitalize on a premium incentive for completing escrow within 25 days of an accepted offer on this pristine, like-new, one-owner residence. Located in the highly desirable, modern gated community of Genesis in Palm Desert, this home seamlessly blends luxury, efficiency, and cutting-edge security. Built with a heavy emphasis on technology, safety, and environmental impact features, the property boasts a tankless water heater, app-controllable entry systems, and an insulated garage door equipped with a battery backup. Additionally, a built-in interior home fire sprinkler system is already in place, offering the buyer significant savings through lower homeowner insurance costs.A charming covered entry porch welcomes you into a bright, sophisticated interior defined by 9-foot ceilings, premium porcelain tile flooring, and custom shutters. The spacious living and dining great room layout serves as the heart of the home, opening directly to a private, low-maintenance landscaped patio featuring integrated automated lighting and sprinkler systems--perfect for seamless indoor-outdoor desert living. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, anchored by a massive white quartz island and complemented by an abundance of dark cherry cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a dedicated walk-in pantry. The flexible den/office space provides incredible versatility, easily serving as a formal dining room or transforming into a 3rd bedroom to suit your needs.The king-size primary ensuite is a private retreat, complete with custom room-darkening window coverings, dual white quartz vanities, an oversized walk-in shower, and a generous walk-in closet. Offered partially furnished per inventory or can be fully vacated prior to close.Enjoy resort-style amenities just steps from your front door, including a sparkling pool, spa, fitness center, BBQ area with seating, two gated dog parks, and walking trails. The low monthly HOA provides incredible value by including high-speed internet, DirecTV, plus water and full maintenance for your front and side exterior grounds. Best of all, there is NO Mello-Roos tax. This prime location offers effortless I-10 access and is just minutes from luxury shopping and dining on El Paseo, Acrisure Arena, and a newly approved community park featuring tennis, pickleball, and basketball courts. Don't miss this exceptional Palm Desert opportunity!

results.remarks:
Indulge in the epitome of Palm Desert luxury living with this breathtaking 3BR/2BA detached home. Nestled within the secure gates of Desert Breezes, this private oasis offers an array of exclusive amenities. The property boasts a Private Pool, Jacuzzi, cascading waterfall, outdoor BBQ island, and a captivating outdoor fireplace, all within the serene backdrop of a meticulously landscaped, oversized lot.

Strategically located just steps away from the renowned Indian Wells Tennis Garden, this residence combines the charm of a gated community with proximity to world-class entertainment. Immaculately maintained both inside and out, this ultra-private haven is designed for seamless entertainment and relaxation.

Step into tastefully appointed interiors, flooded with natural light, and featuring a gas log fireplace in the living room. The formal dining room offers a picturesque view of the pool and waterfall, creating an elegant setting for hosting guests. The kitchen has undergone a complete transformation, showcasing exquisite soft-close cabinetry, pull-out storage units, quartz countertops, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances.

The expansive living room opens to a charming flagstone and grass yard. The jewel of this residence is its vast and lush yard, providing ample space for outdoor activities, poolside lounging, and barbecues. Every detail of this desert oasis has been meticulously crafted, from the variety of mature palm trees to the custom pool featuring a waterfall made from petrified wood.

The Master suite is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring a spacious walk-in closet, a Roman soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a sliding glass door leading to the spa, perfect for a serene nighttime plunge. The secondary bedrooms, thoughtfully situated for privacy, share a beautifully remodeled bath.

Convenience is key with a two-car garage offering direct access to the home. Enjoy the perks of a LOW HOA, with neighborhood pools and spas heated during the winter, along with a recently remodeled community clubhouse featuring a state-of-the-art exercise facility and tennis courts with breathtaking views of the Santa Rosa mountains.

This gem of a property, available furnished or unfurnished, has everything you desire and is sure to be in high demand. Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience this luxurious lifestyle firsthand – contact Denise for a private showing.

results.remarks: Welcome to your next investment or personal retreat in the heart of Palm Desert's coveted Desert Falls Country Club  a rare, gated golf community that is one of the few in the Coachella Valley still permitting short-term rentals. This bright, move-in ready upper-level condo is already an active short-term rental, meaning the right buyer can start generating income from day one - no ramp-up, no waiting. Inside, you'll find an open, light-filled floorplan featuring custom shutters, soaring ceilings, and low maintenance vinyl flooring throughout. The kitchen impresses with stone countertops, recessed lighting, and a cozy breakfast nook, while both bathrooms have been elegantly refreshed with matching stone counters and modern fixtures. A wet bar and fireplace in the living room make entertaining effortless, and the private balcony overlooks a lush, expansive greenbelt. The two-car attached garage adds convenience rarely found at this price point, and the in-unit laundry with washer and dryer included seals the deal. Your HOA dues cover more than you'd expect: cable TV, high-speed internet, and water are all included, keeping operating costs predictable and attractive for short-term rental guests who expect everything at their fingertips. Resort-style amenities abound: over 20 pools and spas, tennis and pickleball courts, a fitness facility, golf course access, and a full country clubhouse. With 1,000 units in the community, there's always something happening  yet this interior location keeps things peaceful. Ideally situated mid-valley, you're walking distance to Cal State San Bernardino's Palm Desert campus and UC Riverside, and just minutes from premier dining, shopping, and entertainment. Own the lifestyle. Generate the income. Start on day one.

results.remarks: Overlooking serene water features and the 4th fairway of the Monterey Country Club golf course, this beautifully remodeled single-story condo offers the perfect blend of luxury and location. Current owner has short term rental permit and if you are looking for an investment property, this one provides top dollar for your investment. Just minutes from El Paseo, premier golf courses, the McCallum Theatre, College of the Desert, and the Palm Desert Civic Center Park, you'll enjoy the very best of desert living. This French-inspired residence features soaring vaulted ceilings, tile flooring throughout, and an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area designed for effortless entertaining. The kitchen is appointed with stainless steel appliances, updated cabinetry, and a stunning natural Macaubas Quartzite countertop with leathered and honed finishes that serve as a true focal point of the home. Offered furnished per inventory, with most furnishings from Restoration Hardware. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated, including Restoration Hardware fixtures such as designer lighting, mirrors, premium faucets, vanities, and hardware throughout the kitchen and laundry. Both spacious bedrooms feature luxurious en-suite bathrooms with Carrera Marble countertops and beautifully renovated showers. The HOA provides exceptional value, covering building maintenance, cable and internet, insurance, exterior painting, common area maintenance, 37 community pools and spas, roof maintenance, roaming security, and trash service. Residents may apply for golf or athletic membership at Monterey Country Club to enjoy championship golf, tennis, pickleball, fitness facilities, and an active social calendar. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity, schedule your private showing today!
